digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary ('Success Criteria' and 'Acceptance Criteria') in reviewer prompts causes the LLM model to treat them as a single pooled bar rather than distinct concepts, introducing noise into rubrics and criteria generation.
The phrase 'Success Criteria' must be renamed to 'Acceptance Criteria' throughout reviewer prompt files and the criteria routing index to standardize vocabulary and eliminate false distinctions.
The generated criteria guide must be regenerated from the updated prompts to reflect the vocabulary change and remain synchronized with the source of truth.

The criteria routing registry version must be rotated to invalidate stale attestations, which is safe only after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) merges to enable grandfathering at the claim gate.

Generic English uses of 'success criteria' in T2 (pilot metrics context) and definition-of-done wording in verifier prompts must be preserved and excluded from the rename to avoid changing semantic meaning.
